name: 28164 · Stanley, NC
findings: ZIP 28164 (Stanley) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28164 (Stanley) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28164 (Stanley) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
